<!--
SHARED FIELD DICTIONARY for the Data Academy lessons — pull it into a lesson with Quarto's include
shortcode, naming this file (see the top of the "What each column means" section in dataset.qmd for a
working example).

NOTE: do not write that shortcode literally in this file, not even inside a comment like this one.
Quarto resolves include shortcodes in a text pass that does not respect HTML comments, so a file naming
itself includes itself, and the render dies with "Maximum call stack size exceeded".

This is the ONE learner-facing copy of what each column means. It is included by dataset.qmd (where the
columns are taught) and by recipes.qmd (the printable card), so a field description can never say one
thing in a lesson and another on the card.

Keep it in step with §9 of docs/LESSON_AUTHORING_GUIDE.md, which is the source of truth for the field
list itself (names and definitions come from WorldFishCenter/peskas-api, schema/field_metadata.py +
scopes.py). If a field is added or renamed upstream, change it in both places.

Plain-language rules that apply here: no Latin abbreviations ("such as", not "e.g."), and keep the
concrete example in the description — on the printed card the example is often the only thing that makes
a bare column name usable.

Tables only, deliberately: no headings and no callouts. Each lesson frames the dictionary its own way and
places its own warnings around it, so anything but the tables would fight with the page including it.
-->

**Which trip a row belongs to**

| Column | Meaning |
|--------|---------|
| `survey_id` | The survey this record came from |
| `trip_id` | The fishing trip. Rows sharing a `trip_id` are from the same trip |
| `n_catch` | How many kinds of catch that trip recorded |

**About the trip** — the same on every row of that trip

| Column | Meaning |
|--------|---------|
| `landing_date` | The day the catch came to shore |
| `gaul_2_name` | The district, or area |
| `gear` | The fishing method, such as hand line or gillnet |
| `vessel_type` | The boat used, such as a dhow |
| `n_fishers` | How many people were fishing |
| `trip_duration_hrs` | How many hours the trip lasted |
| `catch_habitat` | Where they fished, such as reef |
| `tot_catch_kg` | Total weight of the **whole trip**, in kg |
| `tot_catch_price` | Total value of the whole trip |

**About each catch** — one row each

| Column | Meaning |
|--------|---------|
| `catch_taxon` | The kind of fish, as a short code such as `SKJ`, which means skipjack tuna |
| `scientific_name` | The fish's scientific, or Latin, name |
| `length_cm` | The fish length, in centimetres |
| `catch_kg` | The weight of **that one catch**, in kg |
| `catch_price` | The value of that catch |
